records.title: HKU General Information for IAS / NJ / DAS 2027
records.method: Exa web_fetch_exa extraction of official PDF
supportingQuotes: Add / changes to the choice(s) of curriculum will not be allowed after submission of the application.
supportedFacts: International/non-JUPAS admission route differs from mainland NJCEE and local HKDSE/JUPAS routes; qualification and nonlocal status must be determined first.
2027 first-round evaluation cutoff is 2026-11-25 at noon Hong Kong time; offers begin December 2026; later rolling applications can continue until 2027-08-25 noon, subject to remaining places.

limitations: The general document says programme choices cannot change after submission, while the 2027 step-by-step guide says changes are allowed until Nov 25. Do not promise changes; finalize choices before submission and seek university clarification if needed.
Exa extracted content is evidence of retrieved text; direct live-origin bytes/status were not independently captured.

records.title: HKU English Language Requirement

records.method: Exa web_fetch_exa extraction of official page
supportingQuotes: An overall band score of 6.5 or above in the IELTS Academic Module, with no less than 6.0 in both the Writing and Speaking components
supportedFacts: Use the institution's accepted English qualification list; HKU publishes accepted school qualifications as well as IELTS/TOEFL options.
For IELTS planning the retrieved table requires overall 6.5 and at least 6.0 Writing/Speaking in the same sitting, within two years before September 1; IELTS Online/Indicator are not accepted.

Meeting an English minimum does not establish admission competitiveness or programme eligibility.
